FACTS (verified; do not explore). Two small hardenings from a security review of the Claude transport (parity with the ACP path):

(1) crates/ajax-web/src/adapters/web_session_acp/claude_sdk_client.rs, `pub fn set_model(&self, value: &str) -> Result<(), String>` (about line 228) forwards ANY string to the sidecar and then stores it. The ACP path rejects a value the harness did not advertise. `ClaudeState` (boxed, behind `state: Box<Mutex<ClaudeState>>`) has `models: Vec<(String, String)>` = (value, display name) copied from the sidecar's init response, and `current_model`. `set_effort` already rejects unknown levels with `Err(format!("unknown effort level: {level}"))`: mirror that style.
(2) crates/ajax-web/sidecar/claude_sdk_sidecar.mjs, SDK module resolution (about lines 105-135): besides the `--sdk-module <path>` argv route it also imports whatever file `env.AJAX_CLAUDE_SDK_MODULE` names (lines ~118-120: `if (env.AJAX_CLAUDE_SDK_MODULE) { specs.push({ spec: env.AJAX_CLAUDE_SDK_MODULE, via: "env AJAX_CLAUDE_SDK_MODULE", file: true }); }`). That is arbitrary code loading from the environment in production builds; the ACP path's equivalent overrides exist only under cfg(test). The tests only use the argv route.
